name: Auto Weld Chassis and Components
old_description: Finding reliable, high-performance chassis products for a race car, pro street build, or custom street rod can be challenging. At Auto Weld Chassis, we make the process simple. With over 40 years of engineering and manufacturing experience, our team designs and fabricates premium chassis systems and custom suspensions that deliver proven performance on both the track and the street.
about:
Auto Weld Chassis and Components operates from Danville, Pennsylvania, where it has built a reputation over more than four decades designing and fabricating chassis systems for racing and street-performance vehicles. The company does not disclose a specific founding year or ownership structure, but its history traces back to a focus on American-made engineering for drag strips and street rods.

The shop produces a complete line of mandrel-bent frame rails, chassis kits, housings, and suspension components. Its portfolio includes Featherweight and Dream chassis systems, along with custom suspension setups such as 4-link, ladder bar, front-end assemblies, and Featherweight OEM front suspensions. Most parts are manufactured in-house through a vertically integrated operation, allowing custom specifications on each order. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers range from drag-racing teams competing at NHRA national events to builders of award-winning street-legal cars and trucks. The company serves a worldwide client base in the race car, pro street, and street rod segments, with its race-tested designs featured in magazines and on television.

Auto Weld emphasizes its vertical integration as a key differentiator, stating that in-house manufacturing ensures higher quality and greater custom flexibility than competitors. Its products are promoted as race-proven on both the strip and the street, backed by over 40 years of engineering experience and a commitment to American engineering, quality, and customer service.

name: AutoPort, Inc.
old_description: Vehicle Modifications, Port Processing and Terminal Operations
about:
AutoPort, Inc. was established in 1981 in New Castle, Delaware, as a privately held company. The business began as a vehicle port processor and has grown to operate on more than 100 acres adjacent to the Port of Wilmington, with facilities fully owned and operated by the company. Leadership includes Finn Roden, Lois Mundy, and Larry Chismar.

The company provides vehicle modifications, port processing, and terminal operations. Its modification services include truck equipment installation such as service and utility bodies, enclosed service bodies, pit and ramp undercoating, classic service van conversions, and LED compartment lighting. It also offers alternative-fuel conversions for compressed natural gas, propane, and electric powertrains. The site encompasses 90,000 square feet under roof, an on‑site rail head capable of handling 72 multi‑level rail cars per day, and an annual throughput capacity exceeding 300,000 vehicles. Since its founding, AutoPort has handled more than four million vehicles.

AutoPort serves major automotive manufacturers including Stellantis, Ford, General Motors, American Honda, and Volkswagen, as well as commercial truck dealerships and fleet‑commercial accounts. Its terminal operations feature a non‑TWIC receiving area and are structured for high‑volume, quick‑turnaround cargo handling.

The company states its mission is to meet or exceed customer expectations every time, backed by ISO 9001 certification and facilities that meet all automotive manufacturer guidelines. AutoPort also emphasizes vehicle decarbonization as part of a shift toward carbon neutrality.

Initially know as Smart Home Technology, the use of a centralized control of your home features and devices began back in 1975. In the over 40 years since, smart home technology has developed to almost every room and utility in our homes. The dependable and high-quality devices offer not only convenience, but an unbelievable ease of operation. Home Automation systems are custom programmed to your lifestyle and your schedule. about:
Based in Honolulu, Hawaii, Automated Lifestyles Hawaii provides home automation services across the Hawaiian Islands. The company offers custom-programmed smart home systems tailored to individual lifestyles and schedules.

The firm specializes in audio and video installation, smart home integration, lighting control, motorized shades, and network infrastructure. Technicians design and install systems that centralize control of home features, from entertainment to environmental settings. Operations cover all major islands, with a showroom and office in Honolulu.

Primary customers are residential homeowners seeking technology upgrades for convenience and energy management. The company also serves builders and remodelers who need integrated automation packages for new construction or renovation projects. Consultations are conducted in-home at no charge.

Automated Lifestyles Hawaii emphasizes its state contractor license (C-30961) and full insurance coverage as markers of reliability. The business was built on the premise that dependable, high-quality devices should deliver both convenience and ease of operation, a philosophy reflected in its custom programming approach.

name: Automatic Rolls Of North Carolina (Northeast Foods)
old_description: Northeast Foods is one of the largest US suppliers of buns, rolls, and bread products and a supplier of choice for numerous fast-food chains in the country. Proud to be family-owned and operated for 4 generations and counting!
about:
Northeast Foods, which operates the Automatic Rolls of North Carolina facility in Clayton, North Carolina, is a cornerstone of the H&S Family of Bakeries alongside H&S Bakery and Schmidt Baking Company. Together they form the largest family-owned variety baker in the United States, a business now in its fourth generation of family ownership and with a heritage spanning more than 75 years. Corporate headquarters are in Baltimore, Maryland, from where the company oversees a network of ten bakeries and more than thirty distribution centers spread across the Eastern seaboard.

The company produces buns, rolls, and bread products at a scale of roughly 1.8 to 2 billion units per year, offering a catalog of over 250 stock-keeping units. Its bakeries are equipped for large-scale, custom-made production, supported by in-house research and development teams that evaluate new ingredients, techniques, and recipes. Beyond baking, Northeast Foods provides distribution services including direct-store delivery (DSD), FOB, and frozen shipping, backed by RFID-embedded shipping trays and a proprietary web-based ordering platform that gives customers unit-level inventory visibility.

Customers range from major quick-service restaurant chains and fast-casual operators to supermarkets, broadline distributors, and small independent retailers. The integrated network serves more than 100,000 locations, delivering fresh and frozen baked goods to restaurants, QSRs, and grocery stores throughout the Eastern United States.

The company emphasizes its hands-on approach to quality and customer service as the foundation of long-term partnerships. Sustainability is also a stated priority, with programs that have eliminated thousands of pounds of plastic packaging, reduced electricity consumption through LED lighting and smart HVAC, cut carbon emissions via a compressed natural gas delivery fleet, and installed rinse-water recovery systems on washing equipment.

Founded in 1991 in Middleton, Wisconsin, Automation Components Inc (ACI) has grown to a 200-plus employee manufacturer of building automation sensors. The company operates four facilities in Middleton where it engineers, designs, and manufactures its product lines.

ACI produces a range of sensors for temperature, humidity, pressure, current, gas, air quality, and power metering, along with interface devices, wireless MESHNET 900 MHz modules, and BACnet/Modbus communicating sensors. The company states it builds thousands of custom sensors daily and offers customization of probe lengths, wiring, fittings, private branding, and packaging for all volume needs.

Its sensors serve building automation, HVAC, data centers, refrigeration, air handling units, chiller systems, and indoor air quality applications. Customers include system integrators, contractors, and facility managers who use ACI products in air handling units, refrigeration systems, data centers, and chiller systems.

ACI emphasizes American manufacturing, ISO 9001:2015 certification, live technical support via phone, email, chat, or video, fast shipping with no minimum order, and a five-year warranty on humidity sensors. The company says its culture of empowered, long-term employees drives custom solutions and philanthropic achievements.

name: Automotive Machine Inc
old_description: Automotive Machine Inc. has been serving the Great Falls and surrounding area for over 38 years.  Starting out by rebuilding engines in a small shop, Automotive Machine has grown and changed over the years, expanding to its current well-stocked Parts Department and Machine Shop on one side of the street – to a busy, high quality vehicle repair & service center on the other side of the street.
about:
Automotive Machine Inc. has served Great Falls, Montana, and the surrounding area for over 38 years. The locally owned business began as a small engine-rebuilding shop and has since expanded to two locations on opposite sides of 25th Street North: a parts department and machine shop at 813 25th Street North, and a vehicle repair service center at 820 25th Street North.

The machine shop provides a range of machining services including torque plate boring, crank indexing, crank stroking, valve jobs, welding, and magnafluxing. It also supplies fully rebuilt engines for passenger cars and light-duty trucks, backed by a two-year or 24,000-mile warranty. The parts department stocks internal engine components, offers custom mixing of Sherwin Williams automotive paint, and carries a growing line of performance and racing parts. The service center handles general automotive repair and maintenance.

Customers include professional mechanics, DIY engine builders, and owners of foreign, domestic, and performance vehicles. The company also sells wholesale automotive products and paint to shops and individuals, and ships orders nationwide.

Automotive Machine emphasizes its status as Montana’s largest production engine rebuilder for domestic, import, and performance engines. It differentiates itself with a fully guaranteed parts-and-service policy, nationwide shipping, custom paint matching, and decades of locally owned operation.

name: Avatar Natural Foods
old_description: Avatar Natural Foods is a food service company that specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of exclusive gourmet products.
about:
Avatar Natural Foods was founded in 2011 and operates from a 70,000-square-foot facility in Henderson, Nevada. The company grew from the culinary vision of chef Diego Silva, creator of the Eat Pita brand, who set out to make clean, healthy American food affordable and accessible. The business remains privately held and centers its operations around a cluster of sister brands—YaYa's Kitchen, Tuscany Cookies, Eat Pita, Bettr Bowl, and Cali Crumble—each developed in the facility's production and test kitchens.

The company manufactures and distributes a line of gourmet, all-natural food products that span deli salads, Mediterranean dips, grab-and-go meals, baked goods, pita bread, pita chips, frozen entrees, and cookies. In addition to its own brands, Avatar provides private-label manufacturing, co-packing with package design and shipping, wholesale distribution, and e-commerce fulfillment with 24-hour order processing. The plant holds FDA registration, USDA Organic certification, HACCP, and GMP certification, and runs hundreds of SKUs through its production lines.

Avatar serves independent retailers, supermarkets, greengrocers, delicatessens, garden centers, pound shops, cash-and-carry outlets, and expatriate shops across the continental United States. Its customer base spans food-service operators, grocery chains, and online sellers looking for clean-label, preservative-free products.

Silva's founding mission—to replace artificial ingredients with fresh, non-GMO, preservative-free recipes at an affordable price—still drives the operation. The company emphasizes that controlling every step from recipe development to distribution lets it pass cost savings to customers while maintaining a "healthy, premium, and fresh" standard.

name: Averra Packaging
old_description: As a leading manufacturer of medical packaging solutions, we believe the only barrier standing between your device and optimal patient outcomes should be a sterile one.
about:
Averra Packaging is based in West Valley City, Utah. The company was founded in 2013, though its thermoforming roots trace back to a garage operation started in 1989. Tim Neiman serves as CEO, a team that includes veterans of medical device manufacturing and packaging.

The company designs and manufactures custom sterile packaging for medical devices, as well as consumer packaging. Its 40,000-square-foot facility operates a Class 8 cleanroom and is cGMP compliant, with ISO 13485:2016 and ISO 9001:2015 certifications. Processes include thermoforming, in-house prototyping, bridge tooling for production-equivalent samples, and full-scale production supported by an internal machine shop that builds and maintains tooling. The equipment fleet handles volumes ranging from hundreds of parts to tens of millions annually.

Averra serves medical device manufacturers, healthcare companies, and consumer goods brands. Its healthcare portfolio includes custom trays, lids, and fulfillment services, with the company also acting as manufacturer of record for clients seeking a single point of accountability. Consumer packaging projects focus on shelf-impact design combined with functional performance.

The company emphasizes sustainable practices, reporting that 75 percent of its materials come from recycled content, one million pounds of post-production waste are recycled each year, and 96 percent of its products are recyclable. Averra positions itself as a development partner rather than a vendor, offering manufacturer-of-record capabilities to streamline quality systems and documentation for medical device launches.

name: Azuma Foods International Inc USA
old_description: Azuma Foods International Inc. USA (AFI) strives to convey an "Assimilation of Food Culture to the World" by combining traditional Japanese cuisine with the world's many food traditions.
about:
Azuma Foods International Inc. USA (AFI) was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in East Rutherford, New Jersey. The business was created to bring traditional Japanese food culture to a global audience by merging it with other culinary traditions.

AFI specializes in the import, processing, and distribution of Japanese-inspired seafood and specialty food products. Its product lines include tobikko (flying fish roe), masago (capelin roe), dry toppings, seaweed salad, calamari salad, and a range of sushi-grade, appetizer, fry-and-grill, and plant-based items. The company operates an in-house laboratory equipped for pathogen testing using PCR thermal cyclers, ELISA assays, and culture methods, and it develops new products through its R&D team. All foreign suppliers must provide HACCP plans and certificates of compliance, and AFI manages allergen control, gluten testing, and FSVP programs.

The company primarily serves the food service industry, supplying restaurants, catering operations, and institutional kitchens with ready-to-use seafood salads, roe products, and plant-based options. Its menu catalog and recipe ideas target chefs and food service buyers looking for Japanese-inspired ingredients.

AFI was founded on the principle of assimilating food cultures, aiming to introduce traditional Japanese flavors to global markets through innovative product development. The company emphasizes rigorous food safety, with HACCP and SQF certifications, third-party audits, and a comprehensive quality management system that covers everything from supplier verification to in-house microbial testing.
